turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Can I ask something off the record?
Nothing in this room is off the record. Owen's essay.
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
My home is not on the table, Hale. On what basis did you give him a zero?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
Kids who cheat. My son doesn't lie, and you've just told his mother she's the reason he would. Show me a document or I'm walking this to the principal.
